headlines.text: That Saturday in 2022, the ROH World Heavyweight Title was up for grabs as Claudio Castagnoli vs. Konosuke Takeshita went to war, appearing on Battle of the Belts, rated 8.98 ? a match fans still talk about. It was the first title opportunity of Claudio Castagnoli and Konosuke Takeshita's career. Takeshita, still building his reputation through tough losses to AEW's biggest names, pushed Castagnoli to the brink before a Ricola Bomb settled a match many called a true show-stealer.

Rewind to 2025, when Kyle Fletcher vs. Tomohiro Ishii delivered an excellent showing on Collision, rated 8.14. In his first defense since dethroning Rhodes, Fletcher weathered Ishii's brutal chops to retain the TNT Championship.
On a Wednesday in 2025, back when Brodido vs. The Young Bucks met in a Tournament Match on Dynamite, rated 8.45 ? a fantastic contest.
